title: Use a small function
summary: Go: Use a small function. Call twice(7).
introduction: A function can take a number and return a number. This example stores a function in twice.
learningObjectives: Use a small function with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Use a small function

blocks.text: The function stored in twice takes an int. With input 4 it returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Write the return type after the input list.
